snippet.title: Swamp Keeper — Release Trailer
snippet.description:
📌Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689390/Swamp_Keeper/
📌STOVE: https://store.onstove.com/ko/games/101994

🏹One-Shot-One-Kill, Korean-Style Bow Action Arena Shooter
📅Swamp Keeper releases on October 8!

Become the tiny lizard archer, the Swamp Keeper — take aim at your foes and survive fast-paced battles against relentless waves of enemies.
